topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Ah, if the Lord wills, I heard old Jonas speak of fences today. Fences, mind you, between fields that have touched for generations. The earth has been shared, the rain has kissed both sides of our plots without hindrance. I remember the days when my father and his brother would toil side by side, no need for barriers, only the company of kin and the trust that the saints watch over honest work. Times change, they say, but what of the soil that knows not of such changes? The earth is still the same, the seeds still yearn for the sun. Jonas speaks of boundaries, but to me, it feels like something more is being divided, something that runs deeper than the furrows we plow.
